decisions.id: W76-1 lean cap on the settle's turn
decisions.summary: settle_tract_seams admits a turn only where the tract's resulting heading stays within TRACT_LEAN_RAD of the contour or the fall (way_lean <= TRACT_LEAN_RAD), searching the same shifts and seam floors as before
decisions.why: This is the ranked row 197's fix as worded ('cap each tract's settled turn at TRACT_LEAN_RAD off the contour or the fall'), moving the implementation to 0006's rows along the contour or down to the outfall, leaned a little. Implementation-to-research is the GM's direction; nothing is excepted.

decisions.id: W76-2 a tract no lawful turn clears joins a neighbor
decisions.summary: when no capped turn clears the seam, the tract takes the nearest neighbor's number and heading, the existing hemmed-in fallback
decisions.why: The row's fix names this fallback verbatim; the neighbor it joins was itself settled under the cap, and the unit test asserts every tract of the fixture within the lean.

decisions.summary: theta0 = atan2(F.c) + grain_drift, the same expression carve.py::_dry_fields lays its contour from (carve.py:122)
decisions.why: Checked: hem.py:98 passes exactly carve.py:122's expression, so 'the contour' the cap measures from is the one the tracts were laid along. Hem.py's call is the only production caller of settle_tract_seams, so the optional theta0=None (no cap) is reached only by the older unit tests, not by any map - no case is carved out of the fix.

decisions.id: W76-4 tract_heading as the plots' doubled-angle mean
decisions.summary: a tract's one heading is its plots' headings averaged as lines (modulo pi), labeled Research: NONE
decisions.why: A computational means of reading 'the tract's heading' that the row's fix presupposes; it narrows nothing the request or spec asks for and is labeled at its claim line.

decisions.summary: impl-drift judged the open row _comb_dry_and_beans#fork band skipped on villages IN-STEP where the ranking had it DRIFTED/MISLABELED; the row stays open for its own wave to settle against 0010
decisions.why: Not a narrowing: the row is neither closed nor dropped nor re-tiered out of scope; it remains a ranked open row of this feature (ranking.md row 198) to be fixed in its own wave, consistent with D1 (only the current wave's rows are boxes) and the GM's 'fix all of it'.
